text_block_list.text:
One day, during a meeting with Gold
City...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! Can I borrow City for a photo
shoot
right now?
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: Huh? Thought I didn't have work today...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I know, I'm sorry, but we need you!
We've
planned a special feature
showcasing
Umamusume in their
signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
It'll benefit you as well. It's a chance to
make a
whole new impression on the
world!
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
I know. Hey, mind if I bring my trainer to
the
studio?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
There'll be downtime while everyone's
setting up
the equipment, so we can
continue with our
meeting then, right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I end up accompanying Голд Сити to the
studio to
continue our meeting.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay. That's our strategy settled—all
that's left is
to put it into action.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Well... there's also the photo shoot
before that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, City. I like your signature racewear.
Is the
jacket inspired by biker fashion?
text_block_list.name: Stylist

text_block_list.text: Yeah, it is.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I knew it! So tell me—what's the concept
behind
the design?
text_block_list.name: Stylist

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, something I want to try? Anyway,
I'm off to
the shoot now.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Heh, way to evade my question. Good
luck
though!
text_block_list.name: Stylist

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: What is it that you want to try?

text_block_list.text:
Uh, was it not clear enough I was trying
to keep
that vague?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It does have to do with motorcycles—the
feeling
of being able to go wherever you
want, the wind
rushing past.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
See, for this one show a while back, I
had to wear
this biker-inspired outfit.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I wasn't sure how to approach the
catwalk, so I
asked one of the staff
members who was into
motorcycles.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
When you're on a bike, you're totally
exposed,
right? The wind blows right
into your face. In
winter, it hurts like
hell, and it's freezing cold.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But then, that's how you know you're
moving
forward... I just thought that was
kinda cool.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And of course, it's on two wheels, so if
you don't
keep moving, you fall. Or you
use the kickstand.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Never. I mean, I'm a model. I'm just
going off of
what that staff member told
me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
My contract actually like forbids me
from riding
one, to prevent the risk of
accidents or whatever.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: No motorcycle could match your stride anyway.
I'll take you on a ride one day.

text_block_list.text:
My contract actually like forbids me
from riding
one, to prevent the risk of
accidents or whatever.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: No motorcycle could match your stride anyway.
I'll take you on a ride one day.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, please. Where'd you pick up a line
like that?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I can't tell if you were trying to sound cool or cheer me up or what, but those words did not belong in your mouth.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Shortly afterward, the photographer
calls Gold
City in for the photo shoot.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Great job today! The photographer was
really
impressed with you!
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
Great, but let's not do this again. Like,
it's cool if
you need me for whatever,
but today was way too
sudden.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ohh... I'm sorry. But you looked really
good! It
was a side of you I'd never seen
before.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
Did something good happen before the
shoot?
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: Before the shoot?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
"No motorcycle could match your stride
anyway."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"No motorcycle could match your stride
anyway."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Something did happen, didn't it?! Whatever it was, can you make that a part of your prep routine?
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
You always have to push the envelope...
Let's all
get out of here, yeah? We've
got tomorrow too,
so...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Huh, you will? Haha... What exactly do
you mean
by that?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: All right, let's start the shoot!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: Coming.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
By the way, I want to run back to the
academy.
You can drop me off when we
get to the
riverside, okay?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
After the photo shoot, on the way back
to the
school...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Vroooom!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... A motorcycle.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hey... About what you said before.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: How serious were you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити blushes a little more than
usual as she
speaks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
